text: Reduce TSLA exposure — you're paying 165 times earnings while revenue growth is slowing, which is a risk/reward imbalance that is hard to justify at current sizing.
Trim AAPL into strength — you're up 14% and at the 52-week high, but meaningful insider selling is a signal worth respecting by locking in some of that gain.
Reduce IONQ to a smaller speculative allocation — it's losing money, burning cash, and the risk profile is too large for a position with no clear path to profitability.

Open a position in AEP — it has confirmed a high-conviction stage breakout with VCP accumulation, and as a large regulated utility it fits well in an easing rate environment with tight credit spreads.
Consider adding to META on any pullback — 22% revenue growth, a PE of just 16.7, and strong free cash flow make it one of the most fundamentally sound positions in the portfolio.
Consider adding to LPTH — it's up nearly 20%, above its 50-day average, with a bullish MACD signal confirming positive momentum behind the move.
